title: Ines and the Vector
author: Ines Yarrow
blurb: Dominic Lockridge, a clone who inherited the original's murder case, has spent three years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
